home-assistant.description:
Home Assistant is the official open-source Android companion app for Home Assistant, a privacy-focused smart home automation platform.

Control lights, switches, thermostats, cameras, sensors, and thousands of compatible smart home devices from a single interface. Create personalized dashboards, monitor your home, and manage automations from anywhere.

Connect devices and services from brands such as Philips Hue, IKEA, Sonos, Shelly, TP-Link, and many others, with support for standards including Matter, Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread through compatible hardware and integrations.

Features include customizable Android home screen widgets, actionable notifications, device sensor integration, location-based automations, NFC tags, Android Auto support, Wear OS compatibility, and voice interaction through Home Assistant Assist.

Home Assistant prioritizes local control, privacy, and user ownership of data. Connect to your self-hosted Home Assistant installation without relying on proprietary cloud services for local access.

A running Home Assistant instance is required. Optional remote access can be configured independently or through Home Assistant Cloud.
